newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander to sell its 5.5 percent stake in Airtel.
newsitem.headline: Santander to sell its 5.5 percent stake in Airtel.

text.p: Spain's Banco Santander is looking to sell its 5.5 percent stake in mobile phone operator Airtel.
"We can confirm our intention to continue reducing our stake. Still there's no agreement and we mantain all options open," a spokesman told Reuters.
The newspaper El Pais said today that U.S. operator Airtouch could be a possible buyer, increasing its current stake in Airtel from 16 percent to 21.5 percent.

In March this year Santander sold 8.5 percent of Airtel to British Telecom. But BT, with a stake of 16 percent in Airtel, could soon face doubts on its commitment if it should reach an agreement with Airtel's rival Telefonica de Espana, as many expect.
Airtel ended 1996 with loss of 34 billion pesetas. at the end of the year its clients were 652,000 versus 2.2 million at Telefonica Moviles.
